items.claim: Marina Spasic has fought low-level regional competition with many wins against poor opponents.
items.quote: she has not fought the best competition. You know, she has seven wins. I'll say, you know, probably four or five of those don't even count.

items.claim: Marina Spasic maintains constant forward pressure and mixes strikes to the body.
items.quote: she has constant forward pressure the entire time. She mixes it up to the body

items.claim: Marina Spasic increases her volume and gets multiple finishes in the third round.
items.quote: she really starts to turn it up in that third round. I've seen her getting multiple third round finishes

items.claim: Stephanie Luciano is young at 26 years old.
